effective_date_reading: No effective-date wording for sec. 604 ('Executive Order 13834 of May 17, 2018 (Efficient Federal Operations), is revoked'); the revocation took effect on signing, 2021-12-08 (printed 86 FR 70943, December 13, 2021).

targets_in_batch_08.EO:13834: sec. 604 ('Executive Order 13834 of May 17, 2018 (Efficient Federal Operations), is revoked'): the whole order as it then stood. EO 13990 sec. 7(a) had already revoked EO 13834 on 2021-01-20 'except for sections 6, 7, and 11'; sec. 604 therefore ended only sections 6, 7 and 11. The order does not mention the Federal Interagency Sustainability Steering Committee that EO 13834 sec. 4(a) continued.

conclusion: EO 14057 (signed 2021-12-08, 86 FR 70935-70943, read once in full) sets federal sustainability goals (secs. 101-102), agency targets and measures (secs. 201-209, 301-303, 401-403), re-establishes the Office of the Federal Chief Sustainability Officer within CEQ (sec. 501), assigns agency and CEQ/OMB duties and working groups (secs. 502-511), has limitations, exemptions and definitions (secs. 601-603), revokes EO 13834 (sec. 604), makes an EO 13423 determination (sec. 605) and has general provisions (sec. 606). It has no savings, transition or exception provision for EO 13834; sec. 501 re-creates an office rather than preserving the old one.
